stem.text: A circuit contains a cell, two resistors of resistances $R_1$ and $R_2$ and a variable resistor X. The cell has negligible internal resistance.

stem.alt: Circuit with a cell at the top left branch, a resistor labelled R1 with a voltage arrow labelled V1 above it in the top branch, a variable resistor labelled X in the middle branch, and a resistor labelled R2 in the lower branch, with a current arrow labelled I2 on the lower branch.

stem.text: $V_1$ is the potential difference across the resistor of resistance $R_1$.
$I_2$ is the current through the resistor of resistance $R_2$.
The resistance of X is reduced.
What is the effect on $V_1$ and $I_2$?
